text:
kyle-oncall: Pager P1 — sudden session amplification hitting /v1/embeddings. Latency > 2s, errors rising (502/504). Looks like a small set of clients opened huge session fanouts. Paging SRE.

maria-sre: seeing the same. 10k rps to embed-ingest, queue depth spiked on embed-workers-*. 5xx tail increasing. Sampled IPs show same prefix -> likely scraper farm.

adele-security: can we get an immediate IP denylist + WAF rate caps for the suspect prefix? If it's a botnet we should also enable stricter challenge.

sam-platform: agree. I'm pushing a temporary rate-slice on the embeddings route to cap concurrent sessions per IP to 6 and global rate per IP to 10rps. Applying now:

sam-platform: ```
# admin API
POST /admin/rate-slice
{
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "by": "ip",
  "max_rps": 10,
  "max_concurrent": 6,
  "reason": "session amplification mitigation"
}
```

deploy-bot: rate-slice applied (slice_id=rs-2026-03-17-99). Enforcement at edge in ~6s.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-17-embeds-amplification. Severity: P1. Pager notified: kyle-oncall, maria-sre.

maria-sre: after slice enforcement, requests from suspect prefix dropped ~78% at edge, embed-workers queue depth down 60%. Latency improving but still above normal.

liz-support: CX: two customers reported increased 503s ~10:12 UTC. They're both heavy embedding users. Should we prepare a customer note?

adele-security: enabling WAF geo-block for some suspect ASN ranges and raising challenge for suspicious UA patterns. Adding short-lived tunable so we can revert.

sam-platform: WAF rule pushed: block ASN 39765-39770 and challenge UA regex /curl|python-requests|node-fetch/i. Rule id wf-amp-03.

deploy-bot: WAF rule wf-amp-03 active at edges.

maria-sre: embedding queue now at normal levels. Error rate down to baseline for most IPs; two customers still seeing partial errors due to cached failures. Rolling back harshest blocks on monitored customers.

kyle-oncall: handoff — I'm going offline for 20m. Maria will own active mitigation and customer comms. If anything escalates, page infra-ops.

maria-sre: taking ownership. Next steps: 1) keep rate-slice in place for 30m 2) monitor return-to-normal for 2x median latency 3) collect sample sessions for abuse team 4) draft customer impact note for affected accounts.

adele-security: tagging IPs and session signatures in abuse DB. Will open an investigation ticket and coordinate with upstream providers if the same prefixes persist.

liz-support: drafting customer message now. Short note: "We're mitigating an automated traffic spike affecting embeddings. We've applied protective rate limits and WAF rules; normal service is returning. If you're still seeing errors, please reply with request ids." Will post in customer-status if Maria gives OK.

maria-sre: OK to post in 10m. Keep slice and WAF rules; we'll evaluate after 30m for rollback.

sam-platform: creating temporary quota bump rollback guard to prevent cascading failures for honest heavy users. If we see a sudden drop in successful tokens, auto-disable slice for API keys on safelist. Implemented: safelist check enabled.

deploy-bot: safelist toggle enabled (toggle_id=sl-2026-03-17-7).

maria-sre: final note before shift end: stabilization confirmed, queue healthy, errors near baseline. Keeping mitigations for 30m post-stabilization. Leaving logs and sampled sessions in /var/incident/INC-2026-03-17-embeds-amplification for abuse team. Handoff to second oncall in 30m.

kyle-oncall: thx team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-17-embeds-amplification set to monitoring. Updates will be posted to this thread."
